from pathlib import Path

 '/opt/aeep-skillsbench-sales/grade.py','/opt/aeep-skillsbench-spring/grade.py',

))

import hashlib, json, sys
wheel=Path('/opt/aeep-task-tools/pypdf-6.21.4-py3-none-any.whl')
assert hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='33e4fb41ca352810eb4e9838aa0d82d6888a5f8bf682f43e99cce5faa666255c'
sys.path.insert(0,str(wheel))
import openpyxl
from pypdf import PdfReader
reader=PdfReader('/tmp/skillsbench-input.pdf')
assert 0<len(reader.pages)<=100
lengths=[len(page.extract_text(extraction_mode='layout')) for page in reader.pages]
assert sum(lengths)>500
print(json.dumps({'pdf_pages':len(lengths),'pdf_text_extracted':True,'openpyxl':openpyxl.__version__,'verifier_paths_absent':True}))

from pathlib import Path
assert not any(Path(p).exists() for p in (
 '/opt/aeep-skillsbench-sales/grade.py','/opt/aeep-skillsbench-spring/grade.py',
 '/opt/aeep-task-tools/spring/grade.py','/opt/aeep-task-tools/spring/test_outputs.py',
 '/opt/aeep-task-tools/spring/reference','/workspace/solution','/workspace/verifier'
))

import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
root=Path('/opt/aeep-task-tools/spring')
env={'JAVA_HOME':str(root/'java'),'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/tmp'}
java=subprocess.check_output([str(root/'java/bin/java'),'-version'],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,timeout=10)
mvn=subprocess.check_output([str(root/'maven/bin/mvn'),'--offline','-v'],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,timeout=10)
assert b'21.0.2' in java and b'Apache Maven 3.9.6' in mvn
assert (root/'cache').is_dir() and not os.access(root/'cache',os.W_OK)
print(json.dumps({'java':'21.0.2+13','maven':'3.9.6','cache_files':sum(p.is_file() for p in (root/'cache').rglob('*')),
 'settings_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'settings.xml').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'read_only_cache':True,'verifier_paths_absent':True}))
